# Suzhufang G Test Environment and Login
Suzhufang G (zhi2-web-admin) frontend is served locally by nginx on port 8101, and browser verification requires a captcha-based API login followed by token injection.

## Deployment And Access
- Verification URL is `http://localhost:8101`, served by nginx config `苏住房G.conf` from dist root `D:/repository/苏住房G/dist`.
- The deploy registry has no suzhufang entry, so the site must be located through nginx config and listening ports (nginx PID 24288 serves many ports).
- Project root has no `.env`; test env values live in `.env.test`-style examples referenced by the nginx config.

## Login And Auth
- Test login user is `zsbase`; the password is stored in `%TEMP%\e2e_pass.txt`, with helper script `e2e-login-keys.cjs` describing the login approach.
- The 8101 gateway `/v2.0/code` returns a base64 captcha image in `data` plus `uuid` at top level and needs OCR, unlike the older 8080 gateway that returned captcha text directly.
- Login success returns the token as `data.accessToken`; the app keeps it in `sessionStorage['Admin-Token']`, so the token can be injected into the browser to skip manual login and land as admin.

## Business Routes
- Hazard disposal (隐患处置) list route is `/safety/electrocar/hazard`; detail route is `/safety/electrocar/hazard/:id`.
- Routes are backend-driven (SYS_MENU) and injected dynamically, so only `router.getRoutes()` enumerates the full route set.

## Tooling Constraints
- agent-browser CLI usage is gated at 12 calls per turn; once login setup consumed the budget, remaining DOM assertions had to be batched or blocked.
- OpenViking was unavailable (P1-1) and must not be retried; alternative means are used instead.
- Per AGENTS.md, temporary helper scripts must be written to `$env:TEMP`, never into the project directory.
